user.title: Auto Updater
user.description: Install HACS and add-on updates automatically on a daily schedule.

data.update_core: Also update Core, Supervisor and OS

data_description.update_addons: Only shown with a Supervisor (Home Assistant OS or Supervised).
data_description.update_hacs: Integrations, dashboard cards and themes installed via HACS.
data_description.schedule_time: Updates run once a day at this time.
data_description.cooldown_days: A new add-on or HACS version is installed only after it has been offered for this many days. Catches withdrawn or broken releases. 0 installs immediately.
data_description.restart_after_integration_update: Restart Home Assistant when a HACS integration was updated, so the new code is loaded. Cards and themes never need a restart.
data_description.auto_backup: Uses the automatic backup of Home Assistant (Settings → System → Backups). If the backup fails, no updates are installed.
data_description.update_core: At most one of them per run, as the last step, because each restarts Home Assistant or the host.
data_description.notify_service: For example notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Every run with changes is also reported as a persistent notification.
data_description.ignored_addons: These add-on updates are never installed automatically.
data_description.ignored_hacs: These HACS updates are never installed automatically.

error.invalid_notify_service: Use the form domain.service, for example notify.mobile_app_my_phone.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Auto Updater is already set up.
